title: The Lift Mirror Copied Me Wrong #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you get into the lift alone at midnight.
There's a mirror on the back wall. You fix your hair.
You lift your right hand. It lifts its right hand too.
A mirror should copy you backwards.
The lift stops. Floor 13. Your building has twelve.
The doors open behind you. In the mirror, they stay shut.
Your reflection smiles and presses a button.
Would you turn around, or keep watching the mirror? Comment A or B.
